figures.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a new full-width scientific manuscript framework figure, landscape 1536x1024, white background, sophisticated restrained editorial design, exceptionally crisp readable English typography. This is a temporary ImageGen preview for ChemWorld, titled 'How inquiry shapes scientific understanding'. The story is the reciprocal development of scientific understanding and autonomous experimental exploration, not a generic robot workflow. Use navy typography, teal for experiments/evidence, muted amber for judgments, violet only for independent controls. Spacious three-panel composition, labelled a b c.
Panel a at top left, 'A world that persists': show a compact connected chemical process with reaction vessel -> thermal treatment -> separation -> measurement, with one continuous sample-state ribbon under it. Short labels 'Materials', 'Operations', 'Measurements'; note 'State and resource use constrain later experiments'. Draw elegant flat scientific vessel pictograms, not decorative 3D robots. Tiny labels 'Thermodynamics', 'Kinetics', 'Coupled processes'.
Panel b top right, 'Independent experimental control': two separate controls 'World laws' and 'Supplied information' feeding the environment/interface. Agent receives 'Public observations'; evaluator checks 'Executed interventions' and 'Withheld reference responses'. Clearly show a division between public information and evaluator-only references. No implication that agents access hidden laws or reference answers.
Panel c across lower half, 'Understanding develops through inquiry': a large open circular sequence with five readable stations 'Current understanding' -> 'Choose a comparison' -> 'Act and observe' -> 'Establish or revise a relationship' -> 'Next experiment or prediction', arrow back to Current understanding. Make this a living research history rather than software boxes: a short hypothesis note, a pair of chemical intervention sketches, a small response plot, a revised relation note, a branching choice. Next experiment stays inside continued research; prediction is a distinct terminal branch. Below the loop, three succinct evidence questions aligned in a single row: 'What was expected?' 'What did the experiment establish?' 'How was it used next?'. No internal cognition or private-thought depictions, no Einstein, no abduction label, no universal mechanism discovery claim.
Keep text short, all spellings exact. No numerical outcome data. Small readable bottom footer 'IMAGEGEN PREVIEW | Conceptual framework'. Leave generous margins with all labels fully visible. The visual should make experimental choice and knowledge formation equally central.
